title: com.docker.sandbox/workload-token@1
description: Presents the sandbox's workload identity to one relying party: the runtime obtains a short-lived, audience-bound token from its identity issuer and injects it into matching outbound requests outside the sandbox. Instance-shaped on name. The @1 names the capability contract, including this config schema and observable behavior. RELEASES.md defines when versions move.

name.description: Identifies the token among the sandbox's tokens and names it in the runtime's ledger.

audience.description: The token's aud claim: the relying party, or the cloud identity provider that exchanges it, which must verify it.

inject.description: Outbound domains the runtime presents the token to. Every domain must appear in the network policy's runtime allow list (or be covered by a bare wildcard).

header.description: Header carrying the token. Defaults to Authorization.

format.description: Renders the token into the header value with exactly one %s. Defaults to "Bearer %s".

scheme.description: A workload token is presented as a header; scheme does not apply.

username.description: A workload token is presented as a header; username does not apply.
